components.name: Primary Button (dark)

components.name: Audit URL Input
components.description: Domain entry for the hero audit form.

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Instrument panel surface; flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html:
Global Health Score

Readings from eight engines.
components.css: .ds-card-panel { background: #2C3032; color: #F0FAFF; border: 1px solid rgba(240,250,255,0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; font: 400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-card-panel:hover { border-color: rgba(240,250,255,0.2); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }

narrative.overview: CatalystLab is a telemetry floor, not a marketing page with charts. Colour is data, type is instrumentation, and each surface gets one authored moment.
keyCharacteristics: Density through hierarchy, never smaller type

rules.name: The Colour-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Every hue answers what is the state of what; severity never collapses to the text colour.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing readable below 12px; 11px only as mono data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Border or shadow at rest, not both; shadow is earned by floating or responding.

dos: Do route every colour through semantic tokens
Do give every interactive element keyboard parity and 44px of target
donts: Don't put an eyebrow label above a heading
Don't flatten severity into one colour
